sample_unit: questions (16 MCQs and 16 open-ended questions), each asked repeatedly

links.outcome: LLM guideline concordance and scores on dental trauma questions with vs without uploaded guideline grounding
links.effect: With guideline support, OEQ median scores were 32 (DeepSeek) and 30 (ChatGPT, Gemini) vs 26, 20, 23 without; MCQ accuracy 100% with guideline vs 81.2% to 100% without.
links.quote: Guideline-based prompting substantially improved performance and guideline concordance on open-ended questions.

screen.reason: The study directly evaluates the effect of a deployment/prompting guardrail (guideline-based prompting / document grounding) compared to baseline prompting on LLM performance and concordance for dental trauma questions.
